resources.string: ROM not found. Select your Perfect Dark NTSC (.z64) ROM to continue.
Import a mod as a .zip. The selected mod is layered over the ROM\'s files when the game starts.

Twin sticks: left moves, right looks. FIRE and AIM sit along the top edge for your index fingers. In game, tap ◎ (top left) to hide or show the controls, or hold ◎ to rearrange them — drag to move, pinch to resize, Back when done. The overlay hides itself while a physical controller is connected.

Choose Network Game from the main menu to host or join. Everyone must run the same ROM and the same mod. Hosting needs the server port (27100 by default) reachable — on mobile data that usually will not work, so host over Wi-Fi or have a friend host. Tap ~ in game to open the console for chat.
